stable.headline: Claude mode and Animate, two alpha features: follow Claude as a feed, and make parts spin, swing, shake and travel.
notes: Claude mode (alpha): follow Claude as a feed, with your model beside it.
Animate (alpha): make parts spin, swing, shake and travel along a path.
Select all instances, Select the original and Make unique.
Allow, Ask first or Block for each kind of change Claude may make.
A new Settings window, Advanced flatten with before and after drawings, and a rounder look.
Lighter dragging of windows, docks and the console.
STEP files made of faceted breps open, and undo on an exploded view puts it back together.
